stage: CUBE-REV 0.10.5-R1.6 — WCA Results Spine Ingestion, Reconstruction-linkage Court & Public-data Recovery Phenotype Baseline

outcome_only_recovery_proxy.important_limit: The round-result median is computed from the full round result and can include attempts occurring after the focal attempt. This phenotype is therefore descriptive and partially look-ahead-defined, not a prospective predictor, causal estimator, or identified cognitive recovery event.
outcome_only_recovery_proxy.allowed_use: population-scale descriptive baseline and candidate sampling

selection_bias_court.conclusion: Raw reco.nz frequencies are not admissible as WCA-population prevalence estimates without explicit selection correction or tightly scoped conditional claims.

date_field_audit.decision: Reco index Date is diagnostic metadata only and is not a hard linkage key.

scramble_identifiability.reason: WCA Results Export exposes round/group scramble rows but no competitor-level scramble-group identifier in result_attempt records.
scramble_identifiability.admissible_path: Promote scramble identity only when reconstruction-provided scramble text and WCA competition/round context support an exact unique match.

move_grammar_pilot.interpretation: These are conservative route-grammar anomaly candidates. They are not cognitive-error or recovery labels because normal algorithms, rotations/notation conventions, phase boundaries, and reconstruction choices can generate the same local patterns.
